name: Riesling
message: 「...! With my back to the academy...!」
Riesling quickly pulled out a rocket launcher and aimed it at Arden.
The rocket vanished into the sky, dragging Arden right along with it.
And in the sunset sky, another shooting star appeared.

name: Lolotte
message: 「No! I'm the one you saved, Amyrina...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You've always been watching over me, Amyrina. And yet... and yet, I...」
Good grief... Even though it's the perfect chance, they're both so awkward.
I silently placed a hand on Lolotte's shoulder.
Then I gave a firm nod, urging her on.
Telling her to muster up the courage to say the words she'd always wanted to say, yet never could.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Without even knowing how you felt, I... I've been doing such awful things to you all this time... I'm truly sorry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For leaving you all alone until now... I'm sorry. For making you feel so lonely... I'm sorry... *sob*, *sniffle*」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte... Lolotte... *sob*, *sniffle*, *sob*... I'm the one who... *hic*, is sorry」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I always, always wanted to talk with you... *sob*... *hic*, waaaaaah」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, now. You two finally made up, so stop crying already」
I rub their backs to soothe them.
The two of them sniffle together. And when they look at each other's faces--

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Pfft, heehee! Amyrina, your face is a total mess\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee... phew... haah... Crying and laughing like that wore me out\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...I'm sorry for leaving you all alone for so long... just because I was being so stubborn」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's quite alright now. Besides... I wasn't truly all alone」

name: Amyrina
message: 「After all, Jiiya was always right there by my side」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No way... how could Jiiya's tailing get noticed...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Truly worthy of being Milady's closest friend」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Amyrina. Milady has been worrying about you the entire time」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Lady Amyrina. I believe I stressed that you must never speak of that...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Well, I couldn't very well let Jiiya's reputation take a hit, now could I\s04」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You really are kind, Lolotte. You haven't changed a bit since the old days」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Though, I feel like you've grown much more splendid and mature than before」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course I have! I've been experiencing a wholeee lot of things here in the Human World, after all!」
How beautiful it is to get along so well.
